clauses.quote: Adequate protection and security of all school property shall be provided by the Board.
clauses.subject_text: Adequate protection and security of all school property

clauses.quote: Maximum security of buildings and grounds will be maintained.
clauses.subject_text: Maximum security of buildings and grounds

clauses.quote: Such security shall include the stringent control of access to school buildings, grounds and equipment, AND THE POSTING OF APPROPRIATE SIGNS TO DETERRAMAGE OR DESTRUCTION OF SCHOOLPROPERTY.

Costs of repair and replacement will be assessed to those who willfully and unlawfully damage school buildings and/or equipment and to those who are negligent in maintaining the security of equipment or in reporting losses.
Electronic and other detection devices and security personnel may be used to prevent unlawful entry and damage to school facilities and equipment.
clauses.subject_text: Electronic and other detection devices and security personnel

clauses.quote: System-owned vehicles shall be used only for school purposes or as specified or authorized by the Board.
Employees operating motor vehicles belonging to the System are required to be qualified licensed drivers
clauses.subject_text: Employees operating motor vehicles belonging to the System

clauses.quote: are expected to operate vehicles in a careful manner with due regard for school property, private property, and the rights of others.
clauses.subject_text: Employees operating motor vehicles belonging to the System
